# Sitecore Content SDK

> Comprehensive TypeScript/JavaScript SDK for building modern web applications with Sitecore XM Cloud.

## Overview

This is a monorepo of SDK packages, a scaffolding CLI, and sample applications. It provides core functionality, React components, Next.js integration, and CLI tools for creating and developing Sitecore XM Cloud applications.

## Tech Stack

- TypeScript (Node LTS), Yarn 4.12.0
- Build: `tsc` -> `dist/`
- Testing: Mocha + Sinon + Chai, coverage via `nyc`
- Lint/format: ESLint + Prettier

## Packages

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/core` | Foundation: GraphQL client, cache, retry, fetch utilities |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/analytics-core` | Analytics foundation |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/content` | Content client: layout, editing, site resolution, media |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/search` | Search service and APIs |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/events` | Event tracking |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/personalize` | Personalization |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/cli` | CLI (sitecore-tools) |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/nextjs` | Next.js integration, middleware, editing |
| `@sitecore-content-sdk/react` | React components (Text, Image, Placeholder, etc.) |
| `create-content-sdk-app` | Scaffolding CLI & Next.js templates |

## Repository Structure

```
content-sdk/
├── packages/           # SDK packages (see table above)
├── samples/            # Example applications (generated via yarn scaffold-samples)
├── scripts/            # Monorepo scripts
└── .cursor/rules/      # AI coding rules (code-style, sitecore, javascript, testing, etc.)
```

## AI Agent Guidance

For detailed AI agent instructions, coding rules, and operational guidance:

- **[.cursor/rules/](./.cursor/rules/)** — Detailed coding rules: code-style, sitecore, javascript, testing, safety, general, cli, project-context, repo-structure
